sequencing: Numerical GPS movement outcomes of the THREE new source archives were NOT inspected as of this contract. The baseline wolf/deer/elk source effects were previously observed, so these are nonrandom exploratory same-taxonomy source replications, not blind universal species tests.
source_selection: Exactly the three publicly archived single-taxon GPS originals in research/MOVEBANK_SAME_TAXON_THREE_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_20261025.json chosen from 437-source metadata; never choose favorable files/taxa after movement results.
source_only_gate: First check provider original UUID/MD5/byte count and original GPS timestamp/day/night preflight, comparing against the first source-only CI 40159378985 artifact. Original source-only feasibility is necessary but cannot guarantee 0.5–2h displacement supports.
ecological_question: For wolves in Alberta vs Yellowstone, white-tailed deer in Virginia vs Florida, and elk in Canadian Rockies vs southwestern Alberta (population independence unverified), does direction and DAY/NIGHT decomposition of observed matched-photoperiod GPS displacement replicate within the same taxonomic species?
estimator: Use unchanged previously tested scripts.movebank_solar_movement_20261019.analyze_file; GPS steps 0.5–2 h, both endpoints + midpoint in same mean-solar DATE and DAY/NIGHT zone, <60km/h, ≥3 steps per original observed date each zone, one-to-one rising/falling dates in the same Northern Hemisphere year at modeled photoperiod mismatch ≤5 min, separated ≥30 days, fixed source step-count ratio [0.5,2], ≥10 matched dates per marked individual/year; individual-year mean then equal individual mean; 2,000 deterministic equal-original-animal bootstrap re-samples conditional original source animals; outputs retain n and source HOLD for n<5.
eligibility: All three files evaluated even if source-only preflight predicts n<5; do not delete, substitute or weaken thresholds. Compare signs against old fixed source effects only if new ≥5 distinct original marked animals; if below, ecological inference HOLD.
limits: Source study populations differ in habitat, field era, individual sex/recruitment, collar duty and sampling windows. Do not infer species-wide behavioral law, fixed taxon effect or explain effect differences by climate in this run.

Elk source in southwestern Alberta may overlap geographic population range of Ya Ha Tinda elk, although original package DOI and recruitment names differ; do not assert independent population without reference study IDs and animal overlap check.
Minimum straight-line GPS step rate is not active-time fraction or inferred continuous animal movement; bootstrap within-source is not cross-population confidence interval.
Source calendar matching does NOT hold temperature, precipitation, NDVI, migration stage or reproduction invariant.
No source GPS/individual coordinates, original timestamp, individual IDs, event rows or raw telemetry files uploaded to GitHub.

Even opposite signed replicated cohort effects do not prove ecological thermal causation. Any new environmental analysis must use a separately named contract after source outcomes, with true source-date weather and source hardware effort.
publication_position: Show all 3 novel same-taxonomy independent original source outcomes and their previous counterpart in a bounded table, including failures and 0. Prefer ecological contrast to endless modeling.
